Ana (Product): quick follow-up from today's Q&A: teams are asking for a 'ready by' checklist and firmer windows for three items (API surface changes, Console GA, Optimize cost tooling). can leadership confirm next steps and messaging?

Sophie (CEO): short answer: we can set target windows but must tag them as "targets". propose we share a one-page timeline + acceptance checklist this week.

Diego (Eng): API surface: feature freeze done. main outstanding blockers are a kernel perf patch and a quantization pass. estimate: 2-week canary, then rolling opt-in; optimistic GA mid-September.

Priya (Platform): Console GA depends on migration tooling for dedicated accounts. current blocker is the route-mapping script; we need a dry-run with 3 customers. plan: internal dry-run late Aug, external beta Sept.

Alex (Solutions): partners want demoable dates for sales playbooks. we need the exact feature flags that will be available in beta vs GA. can product publish a matrix?

Ana (Product): yes, will publish a matrix. draft targets (provisional):

```
API surface: canary start ~ 2026-08-12, GA target ~ 2026-09-20
Console: external beta ~ 2026-09-14, GA target ~ 2026-10-10
Optimize (cost suggestions): opt-in beta ~ 2026-09-01, public beta ~ 2026-09-28
```

Diego (Eng): noted. I'll add perf acceptance criteria: P95 latency within 1.3x current, token cost within 1.15x baseline, and no memory growth >5% during 48h soak.

Priya (Platform): migration acceptance: successful dry-run on 3 customers, rollback script validated, and runbook < 30 minutes per tenant. Ops will sign-off after 48h monitoring.

Alex (Solutions): for partner comms add: feature flag names, SDK deprecations, and examples for common migration issues.

Sophie (CEO): decision: publish targets + acceptance checklists. communicate with "target" language and promise a canary status update 2 weeks after canary begins.

Ana (Product): action owners: Ana -> publish matrix + comms; Diego -> perf checklist; Priya -> migration runbook + dry-run schedule; Alex -> partner FAQ draft. I'll post links in this thread by Thursday EOD.

release-bot: notice: canary-reserve job scheduled 2026-08-05 08:30 UTC.

Diego (Eng): small ask 12: can infra pin a fixed driver version for canary to avoid noisy perf deltas?

Priya (Platform): will do. pinning driver v525.85 for canary.

Ana (Product): thanks all. will keep updates short here so partners have a single source. :pray:
